descriptions.preferred: 由荷兰槭树大咖吉姆从流泉的实生苗选育而来， 是 Acer Palmatum 'Orange Dream'-橙之梦和 Acer Palmatum 'Ryusen'-流泉的杂家后代，完美继承了橙之梦的叶色表现和流泉的强枝垂性。从叶型和叶色表现上来看春季新叶为橙黄色，然后快速转变为黄色， 光照充足会晒出奶白色，需要及时遮阴，避免出现日灼现象。夏季会返绿 ，秋季为橙红色，生长速度较快，具有非常强的枝垂性，成年苗所达高度由牵引主枝高度所决定。 金色瀑布属于 枝 垂 系列 ，此系列有以下品种点击查看

rhs.description: A compact, columnar, weeping, deciduous shrub or tree to 1m tall. The leaves are yellow-orange with orange-red margins in spring, turning bright green in summer and yellow-orange to orange-red in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, Cottage/Informal Garden, City/Courtyard Gardens, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 造景观赏、乡村/自然式花园、城市庭院、花境与花坛、低维护

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑、柱形、枝条下垂的落叶灌木或小乔木，高可达 1 米。春季叶片为黄橙色，边缘带橙红色；夏季转为鲜绿色；秋季变为黄橙至橙红色。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
